description: This file contains unit tests for the RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder class in the OFBiz framework. It tests various methods that generate FTL macro calls for form elements, such as labels, input fields, textareas, date pickers, and field groups.

classes.name: RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder, contains multiple test cases for form element rendering macro generation.

methods.name: emptyLabelUsesNoopMacro
methods.description: Tests that an empty label text results in a RenderableFtlNoop instance.

methods.name: labelMacroCallUsesText
methods.description: Tests that a label with text creates a macro call with the label text parameter.

methods.name: displayFieldMacroUsesType
methods.description: Verifies that display fields produce macro calls with correct type parameter.

methods.name: containerMacroCallUsesContainerId
methods.description: Ensures container macro calls include the container ID.

methods.name: basicAnchorLinkCreatesMacroCall
methods.description: Checks that hyperlink subwidgets generate proper macro call with style and URL.

methods.name: textFieldSetsIdValueAndLength
methods.description: Tests that text fields set id, value, and maxlength parameters correctly.

methods.name: textFieldCreatesAjaxUrl
methods.description: Validates that text fields create correct ajax URL with update areas.

methods.name: textFieldDefaultTypeIsText
methods.description: Checks default input type for text fields is 'text'.

methods.name: textFieldTypeNumber
methods.description: Tests that input type 'number' sets step parameter to 'any'.

methods.name: textFieldTypeNumberCustomStep
methods.description: Checks that a custom step value is used for number inputs.

methods.name: textFieldTypeEmail
methods.description: Ensures input type 'email' is used.

methods.name: textFieldTypeUrl
methods.description: Ensures input type 'url' is used.

methods.name: textFieldTypeTel
methods.description: Ensures input type 'tel' is used.

methods.name: textFieldNotRequired
methods.description: Tests behavior when the field is not required.

methods.name: textFieldRequiredWithoutRequiredStyle
methods.description: Checks required field styling if getModelForm().getType() is 'single' and required is true.

methods.name: textFieldRequiredWithRequiredStyle
methods.description: Checks that CSS class 'required' is added when required and style is specified.

methods.name: textFieldPattern
methods.description: Validates pattern attribute for text fields.

methods.name: textFieldPatternOnInvalidType
methods.description: Ensures pattern is not set when input type is not 'text'.

methods.name: textareaFieldSetsIdValueLengthAndSize
methods.description: Verifies that textarea fields set id, value, cols, rows, maxlength.

methods.name: textareaFieldSetsDisabledParameters
methods.description: Checks if textarea can be disabled.

methods.name: textareaFieldVisualEditorEnabledNoButtons
methods.description: Tests enabling visual editor without buttons.

methods.name: textareaFieldVisualEditorEnabledButtons
methods.description: Tests visual editor with a set of buttons.

methods.name: fieldGroupOpenRendersCollapsibleAreaId
methods.description: Checks that field group open macro includes collapsible area id and collapse status.

methods.name: fieldGroupCloseRendersStyle
methods.description: Ensures field group close macro passes style parameter.

methods.name: dateRangePickerField
methods.description: Tests rendering of date range picker with many configuration options, ensuring all parameters are correctly passed.
